behavior: The .NET bundle v6 manifest contains ValorInjector.dll (offset 159744, size 146432), runtimeconfig.json, signed System.Management.dll and deps.json. Extracted at declared bounds; no execution of the specimen.

HardwareId.Compute (RVA 0x2164) reads HKLM SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Cryptography MachineGuid and Win32_BaseBoard.SerialNumber, SHA-256 hashes the combined values (machine name fallback). This identifies the licensed machine, not a demonstrated analysis gate.
LicenseClient.ActivateAsync and FetchJarAsync send key and HWID as JSON POSTs to /v1/activate and /v1/files/{agent,client}. MainForm selects the fixed license.valorclient.co.uk server.

JarCrypto.Decrypt (RVA 0x2320) derives a 32-byte key with HKDF-SHA256 from license/HWID and a fixed context; AES-GCM uses a 12-byte nonce prefix and 16-byte authentication-tag suffix. FetchJarAsync passes response bytes through this function before returning.

DoInjectAsync (MoveNext RVA 0x9e98) requires UI phase and a selected Minecraft PID, validates the license, fetches agent/client, writes decrypted JARs in a GUID temp directory and passes client-path|license|HWID to the attach helper.

DoInject (RVA 0x7f08) writes A.java using com.sun.tools.attach.VirtualMachine.attach/loadAgent/detach, invokes javac --add-modules jdk.attach then java with selected PID, agent JAR and parameters. ProcessStartInfo redirects output/error and suppresses the console.

FindMinecraftProcesses (RVA 0x825c) queries java/javaw command lines through WMI and filters Minecraft, Fabric, Forge, Quilt and Lunar markers while excluding Gradle daemons. FindSystemJdk searches JAVA_HOME and common JDK installation directories.

Helper directory deletion occurs in finally; payload temp directory cleanup is registered for selected game process exit and form close. This is temporary-file lifecycle cleanup, not static evidence of forensic log removal or persistence.
The resources are two PNG logos. Licensing and UI code are readable CIL; no hidden executable resource or unrelated credential collection/defender modification was recovered.
samples.verdict_basis: User-operated Minecraft agent injection, explicit licensing and visible UI match the advertised cheat-loader purpose. These dual-use capabilities remain detected. No unrelated hostile action is supported by the analyzed loader or bundled dependency.

external_flag_review.evidence: Download signature belongs to msedge.exe. Dropped EXE execution, DLL loads and RunOnce /burn.runonce registration belong to windowsdesktop-runtime-9.0.21-win-x64.exe or MsiExec.exe. These installer actions do not establish malicious persistence in ValorInjector bytes.

limits: License-protected agent/client JARs are not embedded. Authenticated contents remain unknown; unauthenticated POST checks returned HTTP 401 invalid_license for both. Forager attempted the server root (404) and fetched the product site, which describes Minecraft cheat features.
No deployment evidence establishes whether a user authorized this installation or game injection. The verdict concerns the supplied loader; it does not certify unseen licensed payloads.

behavior: Root exports application/library/init generators. Generator execution writes workspace project/configuration/template files and schedules package installation through Nx devkit. No install lifecycle script is declared.

waitForPortOpen creates a net.Socket, connects to a configurable host (default localhost), retries expected connection failures and cleans up/unrefs sockets. killPort checks a requested development port then calls kill-port. Generated e2e templates use execSync to start/stop development servers.

Templates contain ordinary HTTP routes, localhost proxy targets, Axios tests and Docker build configuration. No obfuscated stage, secret harvest, persistence or unrelated network destination was recovered.

behavior: postinstall updateConfig runs only when cwd identifies node_modules/@nstudio/xplat. It reads the project root nx.json (or angular.json), updates cli.defaultCollection, and writes JSON back. Errors produce a warning. No network request or child launch occurs in that hook.

Root exports the utility module, which also exports/runs updateConfig. Schematics and migrations write Nx/Angular configuration and generator files. Historical migrations generate a local xplat-postinstall.js that spawns the installed ngcc compiler with explicit arguments and relays output.
The child_process source seen by the scanner is a generated ngcc template, not an encrypted install-time downloader. No secret theft, unrelated persistence or obfuscated stage was recovered.
